d:
I stepped outside my comfort zone and tried something new with this piece. It’s a blend of mood, contrast, and emotion that I’ve been wanting to explore for a while. I’m still learning and growing, but I truly hope it resonates with you all. Your thoughts and feedback mean a lot to me.

May this work be received with open hearts and kind eyes.
May it reflect not just effort, but courage to try something different.
Grant me the humility to learn, the strength to improve,
and the grace to accept both praise and critique.
And may those who see it find even a small spark of inspiration within.
n: [Misc] Between shadow and light, I found a new way to create. ❤️ [AI Generated]
